platform_finding.finding: On this Android 16 device, clipboard-change callbacks are NOT delivered while the app is backgrounded: the owner's copies made in other apps produced NO ClipboardWatch listener callback and NO transient 'Copied' alert. The transient alert only ever appeared for a clipboard write that happened while the app itself held window focus (the focused probe write).
platform_finding.interpretation: Consistent with AOSP's focus-gated clipboard: background apps are withheld primary-clip-change notifications entirely, on top of the already-measured denial of background reads. On real modern devices the working save paths are therefore the on-open drain (proven: 3 saves + owner confirmation) and the persistent notification's 'Save last copy' action (same PendingIntent mechanism as the proven notification-tap, targeting the same trampoline activity proven 3x on-device). The transient 'Copied' alert remains a focused-write-only affordance on this platform version.
platform_finding.change: No code change required: CHANGELOG and Settings copy already describe the working paths (persistent 'Save last copy' notification + on-open drain). This receipt records the measured boundary so no future claim overstates the transient alert. CHANGELOG Unreleased gains one measurement bullet.

not_exercised: The persistent card's 'Save last copy' action button was not tappable via adb: Samsung One UI did not render the action row in uiautomator shade dumps (collapsed or after expand attempts). Its mechanism is identical to the proven notification-tap (PendingIntent.getActivity -> ClipboardSaveActivity, an activity proven 3x on-device). Owner can verify with one manual tap anytime.
device_artifacts_left: Debug vault contains: the control text from this smoke, the owner's own manually-copied text, and one neutral home-screen screenshot (source 'screenshot').
Capture prefs are default ON; the persistent 'Vault capture is on' notification is active with its Stop capture action.
Clearing the debug app's data (Android Settings -> Apps -> Cache Vault Dev -> Storage -> Clear data) removes all of the above without touching the production package.
verdict: PASS 9/9 on-device; release-gate item 'real phone smoke' cleared. Desktop pytest (2119 passed, 1 self-reported timing skip), Android build + unit tests (9/9), and real-phone smoke are all green as of 2026-09-30.
